title: Choose the metric first
hook: A queue can look better by one score and worse by another.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that task orders trade off measures such as total waiting and missed deadlines, so the measure that matters has to be chosen before one order can be called better

misconception: One order of tasks can be best on every measure at once.
objective: Compare waiting and deadline misses for one fixed order.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: A queue can look better by one score and worse by another. What is required before calling an order better? Correct option: Choose the objective. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
